observed: local classes with one simple name in different methods (ReduceOps.ReducingSink, Spliterators.Adapter, MatchOps.MatchSink) shared one scope key -> 50 false PURE_DUP rows
correction: local/anonymous type scopes get a unique ordinal (Outer$Local#n); only member types keep Outer.Inner
lesson: a local class is one scope per declaration, never per name

observed: the '>' of a lambda arrow closed a generic depth, so (s,v) -> ... split lambda parameters into field declarators (Utils.v, StandardBundlerParam.s)
correction: top_positions(): '->' never closes an angle; '<' is generic only between identifier-like neighbours
guard: Utils.java field list has no lambda parameters
lesson: depth tracking must know the language's two-character operators before it counts brackets

observed: Guava of(K,V) with <K extends Comparable<? super K>,V> and the deprecated of<K,V>(K,V) reported DIVERGENT: distinct erasures (Comparable vs Object)
correction: method type-parameter section joins the key: name<tparams>(params)
lesson: type-variable bounds are part of the erasure; a signature key without them over-reports

observed: DefaultTreeCellEditor.EditorContainer(): constructor and a void method with the class name coexist legally (JDK backward compatibility)
correction: ctor and method are separate kinds in the key
lesson: javac namespaces constructors apart from methods

observed: m3vcpu_cpu_isa.c m3_cpuid under #if _MSC_VER / #else reported DIVERGENT: the #else line is the first line of the second definition's span, so 'between the spans' missed it
correction: pp-conditional test uses the second definition's name line as the upper bound
guard: 136 C rows are FALSE_POSITIVE pp-conditional, 0 DIVERGENT in .c/.h
lesson: a span that starts at the previous boundary swallows the directive; compare against the declaration line

observed: @SuppressWarnings({...}) before a member opened a block: the paren balance was computed after annotation stripping, which ate the unbalanced '('
correction: paren balance of the raw header decides INIT (statement continues)
lesson: strip annotations for naming, never for structure

observed: .cpp sources: operator new ... throw(std::bad_alloc) and Dll::Dll(): handle(loadLibrary(x)) mis-parsed as functions; C++ overloads need full signatures
correction: scan .c/.h only (task scope); .h keys use qualified name(params)
lesson: C++ needs a real parser; keep the mechanical scanner on C

observed: git blame on the blob:none clone lazy-fetched every historical blob of every candidate file; 136 FALSE_POSITIVE OpenJDK C files made the run exceed 10 minutes
correction: --blame-verdicts PURE_DUP,DIVERGENT: blame only the rows that need an origin
lesson: on a partial clone, blame cost is history depth x candidate files; blame only what the verdict needs

observed: origin/master moved 48537c8e -> 39b0d9e2c6e while the leaf ran (#2501 landed the requireSnapshot fix; m3/collections sources changed)
correction: re-ran the scan and both BEFORE gates at the final base; base sha recorded in GATES.tsv
lesson: a shared .git across worktrees means origin/* can move under you; pin the base sha before gating

correction: yield removed from the control-keyword set (contextual keyword, legal method name)
lesson: only reserved words are safe to blacklist; contextual keywords are identifiers

trigger: patching the scanner via a bash heredoc
observed: doubled backslashes in the heredoc collapsed to single ones; the regex old-string did not match and the patch aborted
correction: regex-bearing edits done with Read+Edit, scripts written with Write
guard: syntax check + file smoke test after every install
lesson: never route backslash-bearing source through the Bash tool

observed: 30 PURE_DUP rows are all imports; 15 sit in OpenJDK upstream files (origin = OpenJDK commits) with no local build gate
correction: --include limits the fix to m3/ and src/jdk.m3.graphics/; upstream rows -> SKIPPED:OUT_OF_GATE_SCOPE and listed for the owner
lesson: fix only what a gate can prove; list the rest with its origin
